---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[Feature]"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## What problem are you trying to solve?
A short description. Example: "I'm always frustrated when I try to [...] in Kode."

## What would you like to see?
Describe what you want to happen. If you can, show how you'd write it in Kode:
```kode
// how you imagine it
```

## Alternatives you've considered
Other ways you solved it, or tools and languages that do it well.

## Is this a language change or a library change?
- [ ] New syntax or language feature (these need a short ADR in `docs/adr/`)
- [ ] Standard library or tooling (`kode` commands, LSP, docs)
- [ ] Not sure

## Anything else
Screenshots, links or examples from other languages.
